title: SIEM Engineer
summary: A SIEM engineer builds and runs the platform that collects security logs and raises alerts (security information and event management, or SIEM). They sit in the security team, onboarding log sources and writing the detection content that SOC analysts act on, rather than watching alerts themselves.
dailyDuties: Onboard log sources and normalise them to a common schema
Write and tune detection rules mapped to MITRE ATT&CK
Build dashboards and searches for investigations
Keep the SIEM platform and its forwarders healthy
Automate onboarding and content deployment with scripts
Fix broken parsing and missing or duplicated logs
Build response playbooks that act on alerts

skills.expectation: Build and run a SIEM such as Splunk, Sentinel or QRadar and write searches

Support investigations with the searches and dashboards you build
Understand firewall, proxy and IDS logs you onboard
Automate log onboarding and content deployment with scripts
